title: baseline: defaults (M0, before any building)
notes: Level with the top nation at minute 1 on 3 of 6 maps, then half its land by minute 3.
Tribes hold 37-96% of the land at minute 1 and nations eat most of it by minute 3; the baseline sits that race out.
Stalls and is eaten between minutes 6 and 14 on 4 of 6 maps; never leaves its home islands on ArchipelagoSea.
Nations nuke from minutes 4-7 in every game.

title: baseline: expandTrigger, expandReserve varied
notes: Both variants survive longer than the defaults (Europe: out at 23.7 and 28.1 min against 6.9) but do not grow: peak land stays at 2-5% on World, Europe and Alps.
Keeping 42% home dies early on ArchipelagoSea (13.5 min; the defaults survive the hour) and on Alps (5.6 min).
Mena is the exception: keeping 10% home reaches 13.3% before it is eaten at 25.2 min.
A longer-lived agent slows the nations: with 10% home no nation wins World within the hour, and on Mena the winner changes from Azerbaijan at 17.5 min to Lebanon at 36.6.
The reserve moves survival, not the stall; the fix is structural (H3 tribe race, H5 strikes), as the 20-game sweep in the ledger found.

title: baseline vs apex
notes: apex wins the opening race: at minute 3 ahead of the top nation on Europe (5.9% vs 4.3%), ArchipelagoSea (9.5% vs 7.2%) and Bering Strait (16.8% vs 11.1%), level on Mena and Alps; the baseline is behind on all six
then it stalls: land is flat from minute 3 to 15 (World 3.6-3.8%, Europe 5.9-6.6%, Mena 6.0-6.2%) while the top nation grows 4-5x by eating other nations; apex never attacks a nation

it survives much longer than the baseline (World out at 37 min vs 13, Europe 25 vs 7, Mena to the end vs 14) but is eaten in the end; on Bering Strait the other nation eats the far continent's tribes, which apex never boats to, and wins at 9.2 min
M3/M4 work: strike nations in their windows, keep boating to food across water, hold deterrence floors

title: M2 sign-off: apex before and after strikes and spawn erasure
notes: the M2 champion (strikes + spawn erasure, 004de76) against the M2 build (2c9ea80) and the baseline, same six games

erasure shows at once: on World it takes the erased nation's northern Siberia (6.0% at minute 3 against the top nation's 4.5%), on Europe all of Russia (9.1% at minute 5); Bering is unchanged (the duel guard refuses to erase)

strikes keep it growing longer: World 9.4% at minute 10 (was 3.6%), Europe 13.4% at minute 10 against the top nation's 10.5%, ArchipelagoSea 14.9% at minute 15 against 12.8%; Alps survives to 23.0 min (was 7.3)
it still stalls at 10-15% and is eaten or out-grown between minutes 20 and 36: the midgame search of chapter 14 is next
